facts.anchor: Mom agreed to the stereo cabinet being rehomed. When I told Georgia, she remembered it and was as excited as I was.
facts.fact: 母亲同意把旧唱柜让给店里，Georgia 听到同样兴奋。

facts.anchor: While I waited for Zak to show up, Georgia and I had a good chat about how well the event had gone and how steady the store traffic had been on Friday and Saturday.
facts.fact: 等 Zak 时她与 Georgia 聊活动效果与周五周六客流。

facts.anchor: “It’ll slow down. People get their toys and stay home to play with them. They forget about the shop for a while,” Georgia said. She’d worked at an adult toy store when she lived in Californi
facts.fact: Georgia 泼冷水：买过玩具的人会回家玩一阵、把店忘了——她在加州成人店做过，产品知识从此而来。

facts.anchor: “It’s like they’re only in it for one thing,” I complained.
facts.fact: Georgia 追问「你跟 Zara 的哥哥在搞什么」，Gail 说 Meg 在调情。

facts.anchor: “Right? Hey, what are you up to with Zara’s brother? Gail said you two were flirting.”
facts.fact: Meg 告诉 Gail 她答应在手术那天陪她，Gail 却说 Georgia 希望她留下看店。

facts.anchor: “I sold him a couple of toys. It was completely professional. But he’ll be here soon to pick up my stereo.”
facts.fact: Zara 带姑妈来取东西，Meg 答应稍后补发唱柜照片。

facts.anchor: “Is that a euphemism for sex? Like hauling your ashes? I should let you go, then.”
facts.fact: Georgia 让 Meg 代接 Negasi 的创业咨询（他想找 Georgia 取经）。

facts.anchor: “It should be, shouldn’t it? No, I have time if you want to keep talking.” I didn’t want to prod her with How are you feeling? but I really wanted to know.
facts.fact: Negasi 从温哥华来，在西区有一家又小又赚钱的店，同时坚持每周演 drag 谋杀悬疑剧。
